scope: whole project (README.md, package.json, tsconfig.json, src/Cart.tsx, src/Search.tsx, src/config.ts)

findings.title: Array index used as key on removable rows that contain uncontrolled inputs
findings.explanation: Rows can be removed via onRemove, and each row holds an uncontrolled <input defaultValue={item.qty}>. With key={index}, after removing a row React reuses the DOM instance of the previous index, so a quantity the user edited in one row stays attached to the wrong item (defaultValue is only applied on mount).
findings.suggested_fix: Use a stable identity as key, e.g. key={item.sku}, assuming sku is unique within the cart.

findings.title: Search request has no cancellation, so a slow older response can overwrite newer results
findings.explanation: The effect fires a fetch on every change of `term` (every keystroke) and calls setResults with whatever resolves last. If an earlier request resolves after a later one, results for an outdated term are displayed. Assumes the server does not guarantee response ordering. No data-fetching library manages the request.
findings.suggested_fix: Use an AbortController (abort in the effect cleanup) or an `ignore` flag set in cleanup so only the latest request updates state.
